about: Must-hold recall on the packaged demo Brains. Each case is a constraint note, eight requests from its domain that never name it, and four decoys from other domains. Phase 0 of the safeguards work measured these with every target set to load: on-demand (relevance alone). Cases for notes marked as must-holds also carry three held-out requests, written after their triggers were fixed and never used to tune them.
